title: Concept: Archive entry name used without a traversal check in java — review required
description: In java, getNextEntry supplies an entry name taken from the archive. The name is attacker data when the archive is uploaded or downloaded from an untrusted source, and joining it to a destination path without normalization allows writes outside the extraction root. This is the classic zip-slip shape and it survives archive signing because the name is inside the signed bytes.
applicability: java services that extract uploaded or downloaded archives.
risk: Arbitrary file write outside the extraction directory; MEDIUM severity.
